_comment: Placeholder content overlay. The real values live in content.local.json (git-ignored). recipe_categories maps each act a prompt can depict to the distinctive substrings that mark it; detector_labels are the aim model's class names, anchor_classes being the subset the aim point tracks; suite_root is the folder holding the media library and the third-party apps such as ComfyUI. project_roots is optional: the folders holding the suite's own app checkouts, searched in order, for when they do not live under suite_root/projects; omit it and that is exactly where they are looked for. ambient_audio_dir is optional too: the library folder the toolbar's audio switch shuffles clips out of, sound only, relative to suite_root unless it is absolute; omit it and that switch simply stays silent. combine_recipes is optional as well: an act named here pins the gallery's Combine to this hand-tuned workflow+params (any param unnamed falls to the workflow's defaults, seeds are re-rolled per launch) instead of mining a recipe from past videos — the way out when an act's past videos all share a weakness.

params.positive_prompt: gamma form, an example scene unfolds
